source: Written 2026-10-16 for this theory copy (Bracket 4). The Stash, Punishers first and Dark Deal: the burst are copied unchanged from tinybones-bauble-burglar.clips.json: every card they show or name is still in this list (none of the seven cut cards appears in them), and their grounding carries over from that file. Discarding moves a card from hand to its owner's graveyard (CR 701.9a); Tinybones, Megrim, Liliana's Caress and Waste Not each trigger once per card discarded. Megrim's damage makes the player lose that much life (CR 120.3a); the Caress is life loss (CR 119.3). The stash: you control a spell you cast (CR 601.2a), so a stashed permanent enters under your control (CR 608.3a); "mana of any type" changes only how the cost is paid (CR 609.4b); a stashed land is played, not cast (CR 305.1), so it uses your land play for the turn (CR 305.2a); the play permission is Tinybones' own ability, so it works only while he is on the battlefield (CR 113.6), and the stash counters stay on the exiled cards meanwhile (CR 122.2). Tinybones' {3}{B}, {T} needs him under your control since the turn began (CR 302.6). Unspent mana empties at the end of each step and phase (CR 106.4, 500.5), so Waste Not's {B}{B} is spent in the same main phase. Dark Deal: five discarded, four drawn. Mayhem is CR 702.187b; Sandman's Quicksand's reminder text says timing rules still apply, so the sorcery waits for a main phase with an empty stack. Entropic Battlecruiser's 1+ ability needs one or more charge counters (CR 721.2a). The only power and toughness stated is the Zombie token's (Waste Not's oracle text). The two new clips use the verified oracle text (Scryfall via carddb --verify, fetched 2026-10-16) for every card they show or name, this deck's notes, Commander Spellbook combos 1290-7848 (Bloodchief Ascension + The Master of Lake-town) and 2607-7450 (Pox Plague + Archfiend of Despair), and the Scryfall rulings (rulings.py) for the Ascension, The Master and the Archfiend; Pox Plague has none. Bloodchief Ascension: its counter ability has an intervening 'if' (CR 603.4) and triggers as every end step begins, other players' included (CR 603.2b); its 2009-10-01 rulings say a single opponent must have lost 2 or more that turn, and it triggers at most once per turn. A discarded card is in its owner's graveyard before Tinybones' trigger exiles it (CR 701.9a); a zone-change trigger fails only at doing something to the moved card (CR 603.6), and the Ascension's drain does nothing to the card. Milling puts cards from a library into its owner's graveyard (CR 701.17a), and two cards milled at once trigger the Ascension twice (CR 603.2c). Damage is life loss (CR 120.3a), so Megrim's damage makes The Master mill too; The Master counts every player's life loss, its controller's included (Grim Tutor's 3), and gaining life mills nothing. A player at 0 or less life loses (CR 704.5a), checked between triggers whenever a player would receive priority (CR 704.3); one who draws from an empty library loses (CR 704.5b). Pox Plague rounds down, as the card says (CR 107.1a); its discards and sacrifices are chosen in APNAP order, then happen at once (CR 101.4); the punishers' triggers wait until it has finished resolving (CR 603.3), so the halving is of the life total before them. Archfiend of Despair counts all the life lost that turn, ignores life gained, and sets the amount as its trigger resolves (2018-06-08 rulings): 30 loses 15, then 15 more, to 0; 31 keeps 1, and any other loss that turn is repeated too. You choose which of your own permanents to sacrifice, so the Archfiend stays (Commander Spellbook: "Ensure that you don't sacrifice Archfiend of Despair").

scenes.head: Tinybones, Bauble Burglar — mono-black discard
scenes.sub: Every card an opponent discards becomes a card you can play: make them discard, charge them for it, spend the stash.
scenes.say: Tinybones, Bauble Burglar. Mono-black discard, where every card an opponent discards becomes a card you can play. Make them discard, charge them for every card, then spend the stash.

scenes.head: Their discards become your stash
scenes.sub: Whenever an opponent discards a card, Tinybones exiles it from their graveyard with a stash counter on it.
scenes.say: Their discards become your stash. Whenever an opponent discards a card, Tinybones exiles it from their graveyard with a stash counter on it.

scenes.head: Your turn: play the stash with any mana
scenes.sub: During your turn, you may play cards you don't own with stash counters on them, and mana of any type can be spent to cast them.
scenes.say: On your turn, you spend the stash. During your turn, you may play cards you don't own with stash counters on them, and mana of any type can be spent to cast them. Their colors don't matter: your Swamps can cast them.

cards.ph: Their card, cast with your mana

scenes.head: Turn 3: [[Burglar Rat]]
scenes.sub: Tinybones came down on turn 2, for {1}{B}. The Rat costs {1}{B} too: when it enters, each opponent discards a card.
scenes.say: Turn three: Burglar Rat. Tinybones came down on turn two, for one and a black. The Rat costs the same, and when it enters, each opponent discards a card.

scenes.head: Three discards, three cards in your stash
scenes.sub: Tinybones triggers once for each card. Each one leaves its owner's graveyard for exile, with a stash counter on it.
scenes.say: Three discards, so three cards in your stash. Tinybones triggers once for each card, and each one leaves its owner's graveyard for exile, with a stash counter on it.

scenes.head: Turn 4: cast their creature with Swamps
scenes.sub: It costs {2}{G}. Mana of any type can be spent, so three Swamps pay. You cast it, so it enters under your control.
scenes.say: Turn four: cast their creature with your Swamps. It costs two and a green, but mana of any type can be spent, so three black pays for it. You cast it, so it enters the battlefield under your control.

scenes.head: Your turn only, with Tinybones out
scenes.sub: On their turns the stash waits. The permission is his own: if he dies, it waits until he's back.
scenes.say: Your turn only, and only with Tinybones out. On their turns, the stash waits. The permission is his own, so if he dies, the stash waits until he's back. A stashed land is played as your land for the turn.

scenes.head: Every turn after: {3}{B} and tap
scenes.sub: Tinybones' own ability: each opponent discards a card. Activate it only as a sorcery: three more cards for the stash, every turn.
scenes.say: And every turn after that: pay three and a black, and tap Tinybones. Each opponent discards a card. It's sorcery speed, so use it in your main phase: three more cards for the stash, every turn.

scenes.head: Punishers first, then the discard
scenes.sub: A [[Burglar Rat]] on turn 2 takes one card from each opponent. The same Rat after [[Megrim]] and [[Liliana's Caress]] is 12 life.
scenes.say: Punishers first, then the discard. A Burglar Rat on turn two takes one card from each opponent. The same Rat after Megrim and Liliana's Caress is twelve life.

scenes.head: Two punishers: 4 life per card
scenes.sub: Whenever an opponent discards a card, [[Megrim]] deals 2 damage to that player, and [[Liliana's Caress]] makes them lose 2 life.
scenes.say: Two punishers, four life for every card. Whenever an opponent discards a card, Megrim deals two damage to that player, and Liliana's Caress makes them lose two life.

scenes.head: Turn 4: [[Liliana's Caress]], then [[Burglar Rat]]
scenes.sub: Tinybones came down on turn 2 and Megrim on turn 3. The Caress and the Rat cost {1}{B} each; cast the Caress first.
scenes.say: Turn four. Tinybones came down on turn two, and Megrim on turn three. Now Liliana's Caress, then Burglar Rat, for one and a black each. The Caress goes first, so both punishers see the discards.

scenes.head: Each opponent discards: 12 life
scenes.sub: Each takes 2 damage from Megrim and loses 2 to the Caress: 4 each, 12 across three opponents. Tinybones stashes all three cards.
scenes.say: The Rat enters, and each opponent discards a card. Each one takes two damage from Megrim and loses two life to the Caress: four each, twelve across three opponents. And Tinybones stashes all three cards.

scenes.head: [[Waste Not]]: every discard pays you
scenes.sub: Whenever an opponent discards a creature card, create a 2/2 black Zombie. A land card: add {B}{B}. Anything else: draw a card.
scenes.say: Waste Not: every discard pays you. Whenever an opponent discards a creature card, you create a two-two black Zombie. A land card adds two black mana. Anything else draws you a card.

scenes.head: Turn 5: [[Waste Not]], then [[Hecteyes]]
scenes.sub: Hecteyes makes each opponent discard. A creature card: a Zombie. A land: {B}{B}. An instant: a card. And 12 more life.
scenes.say: Turn five: Waste Not, then Hecteyes, one and a black each. Each opponent discards: a creature card makes you a Zombie, a land gives you two black mana, an instant draws you a card. And that's twelve more life.

scenes.head: Spend Waste Not's {B}{B} this phase
scenes.sub: Unspent mana empties when the phase ends. {B}{B} and your fifth Swamp cast a three-mana card from the stash.
scenes.say: Spend Waste Not's mana in this phase: unspent mana empties when the phase ends. Two black from Waste Not, plus your fifth Swamp, casts a three-mana card from the stash.

scenes.head: More punishers in the 99
scenes.sub: [[Raiders' Wake]] and [[Fell Specter]]: 2 life per discard. [[Entropic Battlecruiser]]: 3, from one charge counter. [[Geth's Grimoire]]: you may draw.
scenes.say: More punishers in the ninety-nine. Raiders' Wake and Fell Specter each make them lose two life per discard. Entropic Battlecruiser makes it three, once it has a charge counter. And Geth's Grimoire lets you draw a card.

scenes.head: [[Dark Deal]]: every hand at once
scenes.sub: {2}{B}: each player discards all the cards in their hand, then draws that many cards minus one.
scenes.say: Dark Deal: every hand, all at once. For two and a black, each player discards all the cards in their hand, then draws that many cards minus one.

scenes.head: Turn 7: [[Megrim]] and [[Liliana's Caress]] are out
scenes.sub: Each opponent holds five cards. Three of your seven [[Swamp|Swamps]] cast Dark Deal: each opponent discards five, then draws four.
scenes.say: Turn seven. Megrim, Liliana's Caress and Waste Not are already out, and each opponent holds five cards. Three of your seven Swamps cast Dark Deal: each opponent discards five cards, then draws four.

scenes.head: Five cards each: each opponent loses 20
scenes.sub: Each card: 2 damage from Megrim, 2 life to the Caress. Five cards at 4 each: 20 apiece, 60 from one sorcery.
scenes.say: Five cards each, so each opponent loses twenty. Every card they discard is two damage from Megrim and two life lost to Liliana's Caress. Five cards at four each is twenty apiece: sixty life from one sorcery.

scenes.head: Fifteen cards for your stash
scenes.sub: Tinybones exiles every one with a stash counter, and [[Waste Not]] pays for each: Zombies, {B}{B} per land, cards for the rest.
scenes.say: All fifteen cards go to your stash. Tinybones exiles every one with a stash counter, and Waste Not pays you for each: a Zombie for every creature card, two black mana for every land, and a card for the rest.

scenes.head: Your hand goes too
scenes.sub: You discard yours and draw one fewer. Cast Dark Deal when your hand is small, and make [[Sandman's Quicksand]] the card you discard.
scenes.say: Your hand goes too: you discard yours and draw one fewer. So cast Dark Deal when your hand is small, and make Sandman's Quicksand the card you throw away.

scenes.head: [[Sandman's Quicksand]]: mayhem {3}{B}
scenes.sub: You may cast it from your graveyard for {3}{B} if you discarded it this turn. Timing rules still apply: it's a sorcery.
scenes.say: Sandman's Quicksand has mayhem. You may cast it from your graveyard for three and a black if you discarded it this turn. Timing rules still apply: it's a sorcery, so your main phase, with the stack empty.

scenes.head: Same main phase: [[Sandman's Quicksand|Quicksand]] for {3}{B}
scenes.sub: Once [[Dark Deal]] and its triggers resolve, pay {3}{B}: creatures your opponents control get -2/-2 until end of turn. Yours don't.
scenes.say: Same main phase: Quicksand for mayhem. Once Dark Deal and its triggers resolve, your other four Swamps pay three and a black. Creatures your opponents control get minus two minus two until end of turn, and yours don't.

scenes.head: Punishers out, hands full: then Dark Deal
scenes.sub: Hold it for full hands. If the table draws a new seven, that's when it hits hardest.
scenes.say: Punishers out, hands full: then Dark Deal. Hold it for full hands. If the table draws a fresh seven, that's when it hits hardest.

scenes.head: [[Bloodchief Ascension]]: {B}, then three counters
scenes.sub: At the beginning of each end step, if an opponent lost 2 or more life this turn, you may put a quest counter on it.
scenes.say: Bloodchief Ascension, for one black. At the beginning of each end step, if an opponent lost two or more life this turn, you may put a quest counter on it. You want three.

scenes.head: Turn 4: the Ascension, then [[Burglar Rat]]
scenes.sub: [[Megrim]] came down on turn 3. The Rat's discards cost 2 each, so your end step earns counter 1. Theirs count too.
scenes.say: Turn four: the Ascension, then Burglar Rat. With Megrim out, each discard costs two, so your end step earns a counter. Their end steps count too, one per turn.

scenes.head: Three counters: every card costs them 2
scenes.sub: Whenever a card is put into an opponent's graveyard from anywhere, you may have that player lose 2 life. If you do, you gain 2 life.
scenes.say: At three or more counters: whenever a card is put into an opponent's graveyard from anywhere, you may have that player lose two life. If you do, you gain two.

scenes.head: [[The Master of Lake-town]]: {1}{B}{B}
scenes.sub: Whenever a player loses life, that player mills that many cards. Damage causes loss of life, so damage counts too.
scenes.say: The Master of Lake-town, for one and two black. Whenever a player loses life, that player mills that many cards. Damage causes loss of life, so damage counts too.

scenes.head: Turn 6: Tinybones, {3}{B} and tap
scenes.sub: The Master came down on turn 5, and the Ascension has three counters. Each opponent discards a card: three chains start.
scenes.say: Turn six, with three counters and The Master out. Tap Tinybones for three and a black: each opponent discards. Each card hits the graveyard before he exiles it, so all three count.

scenes.head: Drain 2, mill 2, and again
scenes.sub: Opponent 1's card hits their graveyard before Tinybones exiles it: the Ascension drains 2. The Master mills 2, and each milled card drains 2 more.
scenes.say: Opponent one's card hits the graveyard before Tinybones exiles it, so the Ascension drains two. The Master mills two, and each milled card drains two more: four life, four cards, then eight.

scenes.head: The chain feeds itself
scenes.sub: Every 2 life mills 2 cards, and every card milled costs 2 more. It runs until their life or library runs out.
scenes.say: Every two life mills two cards, and every card milled costs two more. It runs until their life or library runs out. Megrim's damage on the discard starts a second chain.

scenes.head: [[The Master of Lake-town|The Master]] mills you too
scenes.sub: It's whenever a player loses life: [[Grim Tutor]]'s 3 life mills you 3. The Ascension's 2 is life you gain, and gaining mills nothing.
scenes.say: The Master mills you too: it's whenever a player loses life. Grim Tutor's three life mills you three cards. The Ascension's two is life you gain, and gaining life mills nothing.

scenes.head: [[Pox Plague]]: {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}, everyone halved
scenes.sub: Each player loses half their life, then discards half their hand, then sacrifices half their permanents, of their choice. Round down each time.
scenes.say: Pox Plague, for five black. Each player loses half their life, then discards half their hand, then sacrifices half their permanents, of their choice. Round down each time.

scenes.head: [[Archfiend of Despair]]: the same loss again
scenes.sub: {6}{B}{B}, flying. Your opponents can't gain life. At the beginning of each end step, each opponent loses life equal to the life they lost this turn.
scenes.say: Archfiend of Despair, for six and two black. Your opponents can't gain life, and at the beginning of each end step, each opponent loses life equal to the life they lost this turn.

scenes.head: Missing a piece? Tutor for it
scenes.sub: [[Diabolic Tutor]]: any card. [[Grim Tutor]]: any card, and you lose 3 life. [[Final Parting]]: two cards, one to your hand, one to your graveyard.
scenes.say: Missing a piece of either combo? Tutor for it. Diabolic Tutor finds any card. Grim Tutor finds any card, for three life. Final Parting finds two: one for your hand, one for your graveyard.

scenes.head: Turn 8: [[Archfiend of Despair|the Archfiend]] first, then [[Pox Plague]]
scenes.sub: Pox Plague halves you too, so the Archfiend comes first. Five [[Swamp|Swamps]] cast it. Each opponent: 30 life, four cards.
scenes.say: Turn eight, with the Archfiend out since last turn. Pox Plague halves you too, so cast it only with the Archfiend out. Each opponent is at thirty, with four cards in hand.

scenes.head: Half their life, then half their hand
scenes.sub: Each opponent drops from 30 to 15. Then each discards two of their four cards, and Tinybones stashes all six.
scenes.say: Each opponent loses half their life: thirty becomes fifteen. Then each discards two of their four cards, and Tinybones exiles all six with stash counters.

scenes.head: Then half their permanents, and yours
scenes.sub: Each player sacrifices half their permanents, of their choice. You pay half of everything too, so pick yours and keep the Archfiend.
scenes.say: Then each player sacrifices half their permanents, of their choice. You pay half too: half your life, half your hand, half your permanents. You pick yours, so keep the Archfiend.

scenes.head: Your end step: [[Archfiend of Despair|the Archfiend]] takes 15 more
scenes.sub: Each opponent lost 15 this turn, so each loses 15 again, and none can gain life back. 30, then 15, then 0.
scenes.say: Your end step: the Archfiend triggers. Each opponent lost fifteen this turn, so each loses fifteen more, and none can gain life. Thirty, fifteen, zero: they lose the game.

scenes.head: At an odd total, they keep 1
scenes.sub: Half of 31 rounds down to 15: 16 left, then 1 after the Archfiend. Any other loss finishes them: [[Megrim]] makes each discard cost 2.
scenes.say: At an odd total, they keep one: thirty-one loses fifteen, then fifteen more. Any other loss finishes them, and with Megrim out, every discard costs two.

scenes.head: Tinybones, Bauble Burglar
scenes.sub: Bracket 4 · the full plan is in the Plan tab.
scenes.say: Tinybones, Bauble Burglar. Bracket four, with two combos and three tutors. The full plan is in the Plan tab.
